operational_impact_guidelines.LOW: Branch lines / sidings, < 25 trains/day, minimal passenger delay risk
operational_impact_guidelines.MEDIUM: Standard double-track routes, 25-75 trains/day, manageable rerouting / headway buffer
operational_impact_guidelines.HIGH: Heavy trunk routes, 75-140 trains/day, high cascade delay potential
operational_impact_guidelines.CRITICAL: Super-dense corridors / Golden Quadrilateral / junction bottlenecks, > 140 trains/day, catastrophic network impact
